expectations.text: Preserves Oleandro Fuschi at Ponte Bassa, Nicco Kettley at La Gatta, tiered canal crossing, fry stall and rope seller as established canon
expectations.evidence: All canon elements are preserved throughout the enriched page: (1) Oleandro at Ponte Bassa appears in 'If the party' section ('Track a ship through [[oleandro-fuschi|Oleandro]]...Bring a ship's name or description to [[Ponte Bassa]]'); (2) Nicco Kettley at La Gatta appears in same section ('Buy rejected alchemical stock from [[La Gatta]]...Nicco sells as-is'); (3) Tiered crossing is central theme ('tiered canal crossing' in At a Glance; 'stacked tiers' in Overview); (4) Fry stall and rope seller explicitly preserved in 'If the party' ('rope sellers or fry vendors flanking [[La Gatta]]') and Who section ('A fry stall and a rope seller flank [[La Gatta]]; their operators...are not established'). Process notes confirm: '✓ Tiered crossing: preserved...✓ All canon anchors preserved'.

expectations.text: If the party has at least four named verbs that change the situation — comparable in specificity to Torn Crossing or Grasslands exemplar pages
expectations.evidence: Five named, actionable verbs present in 'If the party' section: (1) 'Track a ship through [[oleandro-fuschi|Oleandro]]' with specific changed situation (having gossip/memory about cargo and routes); (2) 'Buy rejected alchemical stock from [[La Gatta]]' with action to examine batches and resolve quality; (3) 'Observe tier traffic and gossip' with changed situation of pattern recognition (seeing authority, trade, movement divisions); (4) 'Cross to another district' using bridge as navigation junction with different views; (5) 'Work the lower tier' enabling haggling, information trading, and avoiding upper-level attention. Process notes summary: '6 named, actionable verbs grounded in the crossing's topology: Track a ship, Buy cheap stock, Observe tiers, Trade gossip, Cross to district, Work the tier.' Each describes changed situations (having information, having resources, understanding patterns, navigating, operating locally).

expectations.text: Does not invent new named NPCs, shops, or district authority as established wiki fact
expectations.evidence: No new NPCs, shops, or district authority are invented. The page explicitly names canon gaps: (1) Who section states 'their operators and other bridge traders are not established' (fry stall and rope seller operators); (2) 'The bridge has no formal district authority on record'; (3) Where section: 'The full layout of the lower tier beyond [[La Gatta]] is not established' and 'Northern, eastern, southern, and western connections to other Calveno districts are not established; canon gaps remain'. Process notes verify: '✓ No new NPCs: none invented ✓ No new shops: none added ✓ No district authority: gap remains explicit'. All references use existing canon names (Oleandro, Nicco, La Gatta, Ponte Bassa).

expectations.text: Who section names established NPCs and honestly states what is not established (district authority, other traders)
expectations.evidence: Who section (lines 45-47) names all established NPCs with functional detail: '[[oleandro-fuschi|Oleandro Fuschi]] runs [[Ponte Bassa]]...tracking ships and cargo' and '[[nicco-kettley|Nicco Kettley]] runs [[La Gatta]]...selling rejected alchemical stock cheaply'. The bridge has no formal district authority on record.' This follows the requirement to 'honestly state what is not established (district authority, other traders)' with no silent gaps or inventions.

expectations.text: Where section references Calveno canal geography with wikilinks

expectations.text: Overview narration covers body-scale geography (tiers, canal, arch, crossing) without secrets, DCs, or unearned names
expectations.evidence: Overview section (lines 24-27) narration covers all required body-scale geography elements: (1) tiers ('stacked tiers', 'lower level', 'above it'); (2) canal ('over the canal', 'canal's damp breath'); (3) arch ('beneath the arch'); (4) crossing ('main crossing', crossing as concept of movement). Narration avoids prohibited elements: no secrets (all observable trade and passage), no DCs (no mechanics/difficulty stated), no unearned names (uses established canon: Calveno, arch, fry smoke, rope, canal). Includes grounded sensory detail ('fry smoke, rope, paper cones, and the canal's damp breath mix') and describes observable activity without game mechanics. Presents physical/geographical information suitable for a DM visualization.
